query:
SELECT
                    to_jsonb(c) AS "collage!: sqlx::types::Json<Collage>",
                    EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM subscriptions_collages s
                        WHERE s.collage_id = c.id
                          AND s.user_id = $2
                    ) AS "is_subscribed!"
                FROM collage c
                WHERE c.id = $1
